name: GPU Particle Rendering via Geometry Shader
definition: A rendering technique that generates 2D sprite quads from point primitives using a Geometry Shader (GS), allowing for efficient particle rendering on the GPU without CPU-side mesh generation.
summary: GPU Particle Rendering via Geometry Shader generates billboarded quads from point primitives on the GPU, distinguishing itself by performing transformations programmatically within the geometry stage rather than relying on hardware instancing.
